integrity: The unique seven-vertex torus triangulation is reconstructed by an explicit cyclic facet list. The verifier checks manifold incidence and orientability, rebuilds the source face-incidence generator, reproduces the published \([42,7,13]_2\) parameters, and exhaustively enumerates all \(29211\) positive-dimensional message subspaces.
scientific_limitations: The result is an exact finite higher-support classification for the seven-vertex torus code in Example 5.3. It does not give a general formula for arbitrary triangulated surfaces or arbitrary simplicial complexes, and it does not classify subcodes up to automorphism.
title: Complete higher-support profile of the minimal-torus \([42,7,13]_2\) code
